recipe.title: Butter chicken
recipe.notes: This recipe is from Nadia Lim's book, 'Yum!'.
recipe.serves: Serves two adults and two children.

i.n: carrot or pumpkin, finely diced or grated

method.s: Pat chicken dry and dice 2cm. Toss in a bowl to coat with spices, ginger (not garlic) and salt.
Heat butter in a large pan on medium heat. Cook onion and carrot/pumpkin for a few minutes until softened.
Add garlic and cook a further 1-2 minutes. Add chicken and cook for 3-5 minutes, turning, until golden and nearly cooked through.
Add cream, milk, tomato paste, vinegar and sweet chili sauce. Stir to combine.
Simmer for 5-10 minutes until chicken is cooked through and sauce has thickened slightly.
Serve with steamed rice and green vegetables.
